raw_segments.text: On a certain occasion when the finches were assembled in force, and when good feeling
was being promoted in the usual manner by nobodies agreeing with anybody else, the presiding
finch called the grove to order, for as much as Mr. Drummel had not yet toasted a lady—which,
according to the solemn constitution of the Society, it was the brute's turn to do that
I thought I saw him leer in an ugly way at me while the decanters were going round, but
as there was no love lost between us, that might easily be.
What was my indignant surprise when he called upon the company to pledge him to Estella?
